name: Hasty Pudding
text: Belly 1. Start of Combat: swallow the enemy across.
golden_text: Belly 2. Start of Combat: swallow the enemy across and the one nearest it.
details: It goes back when this dies, after 3 of your units die, or when its side has nobody else.
golden_details: They go back when this dies, after 3 of your units die, or when their side has nobody else.
